articles.title: Canada Fires Back: New Tariffs on U.S. Goods!
articles.summary: Canada is putting new taxes on U.S. products starting September 8. This is payback for U.S. tariffs. Over 700 items will cost more, including steel and appliances.

articles.title: Malaysia's Leader Says Taiwan Is Part of China—Why It Matters
articles.summary: Malaysia's prime minister said Taiwan is part of China, which made China happy and Taiwan upset. He also talked about using force to keep countries together. This could change how Malaysia deals with other countries.

articles.title: Why Canada and the U.S. Almost Had a Deal—But Didn't
articles.summary: Canada and the U.S. almost made a trade deal, but talks broke down over cars and steel. Now they're heading toward a trade war. Find out what happened!
